findings.title: Shard-split queries are interpolated twice
findings.body: runShardSplitQuery() now maps every target through datasource.applyTemplateVariables(), and then splitQueriesByStreamShard() passes each shard sub-request to runSplitQuery(), which at querySplitting.ts:299 maps the same targets through applyTemplateVariables() again (the updated test even expects 5 calls for a single query: 1 here plus 1 per shard sub-request). applyTemplateVariables() is not guaranteed to be idempotent: a template-variable value containing a $-prefixed string, an $__auto/$__interval-derived step, or ad-hoc filter handling can be rewritten differently on the second pass, and the second pass runs after interpolateShardingSelector() has injected the __stream_shard__ matcher into the expression. Interpolate only once, e.g. by having runSplitQuery() skip interpolation for requests already interpolated by the shard path or by removing the interpolation here and relying on runSplitQuery().

findings.title: Empty-expression filter runs before interpolation, not after
findings.body: The targets are filtered with .filter((query) => query.expr) before .map(applyTemplateVariables). A target whose expression is only a template variable, e.g. expr='$myQuery', passes the filter, but if the variable interpolates to an empty string the resulting empty query is no longer filtered out; it is then classified by isLogsQuery(''), grouped, and sent to the backend in a sub-request instead of being ignored like other empty queries. Move the empty-expression check to after interpolation (keeping the pre-filter if needed to avoid interpolating empty strings).
